title: The second front: the swarm cracks the sealed mouth behind the bays, and the story is no longer sector-gated
context: Owner: "at some point we must protect the OTHER SIDE OF THE BASE." V1 session design, sector 2 THE BACK DOOR. The story planet has 18 clearing mouths and only the gate's (frame [0,-155]) is open; buildStoryPlanet recomputes the sealed ones on every load, but td-tab keeps only the planet's mesh and dungeon. td-tab is at its line budget. The investigation notes flagged a risk that applySector's round 1 also runs in the story and seals the outer world.
outcome: src/domain/back-door.js (pure): findBackMouth picks the sealed mouth nearest frame +Z that touches the clearing, leads out (reach share 0.5) and is at most 2 cells wide: cells [1086, 34817] at bearing 11.6 deg, frame [32, 154], open lane beyond [1257, 34816], plus a flank of four rock cells [1084, 34814, 45955, 34815] that come down with it. backBreachCells keeps open lane cells 25-35 hops out from the mouth whose route with the collapse open is at least 20 hops shorter than through the gate alone; the collapse (mouth plus flank) is closed for the gate field and opened for the back field, so the answer is identical before and after the collapse: 272 cells, 40-51 hops from the heart (gate route 75+). Tunables in STORY_BACK_DOOR (src/content/story-defaults.js). story-world.js carries story.backMouth, story.backDoor and story.backPlanet { graph, clearing }. src/fx/dive-shot.js takes the sinkhole's establishing dive out of td-tab (startDiveShot(hooks, direction, { preRoll, hold, tail, dive })); the breach uses it unchanged and the collapse uses it with its own pose (3 cells up, 6 cells out over the rock, the mouth centred with the bays and the Stalheart beyond). storyApi.openBackDoor(): breachWallCell on the six cells, one rebuildAfterBreach, one recomputePortalDist, a tank.shell explosion per cell, sinkhole_quake, Isao's back_door brief ("They cracked the back wall!" / "Build towers behind the bays."), a BACK DOOR diamond on the radar (story-hud back(dir)) and the dive; idempotent via story.backOpen (reset by a new world). storyApi.backDoorOpen() and storyApi.backBreachCandidates() -> [{ cell, side: 'back', hops, route, pos }] (hops: the route once the back is open; route: the live field now). SECTOR GATING WAS ACTIVE: at stage 6 the story had 68,497 rock cells and 'sector 1: 2817 open cells'; rocket-a, rocket-d and wreck-b had no route to the heart. Fix, two same-line changes in td-tab: tdSectorId.fill(storyMode ? 1 : 6) and applySector(!storyMode), the second so the story keeps its own lane-end spawn (plan.cells.fodder, 19498) instead of the planet's farthest cell 276 hops out; spawnFodder's breach then lands on cell 55727 (69 hops, 13.5 cells from the lane end) instead of 56569 (72 hops), both routes joining 35 hops out, outside the gate. Acceptance hooks: openBackDoor, backDoorOpen, backCandidates, backMouth, backBreach(n, k) (a real breach on candidate k with n fodder queued on its own spawn point, leaving story.source alone), backInside (alive bodies inside the clearing on the mouth's half), viewBack(height, back). td-tab 13,858 -> 13,856 lines.
alternatives: Gate only the mouth cells in the back-breach test; rejected: once the flank rock is down it is a second way through the same wall and the gate-only field found no back cells at all after the collapse.

Only fill the sector map with 1 in the story; rejected: applySector(true) then re-picks the spawn as the planet's farthest open cell (276 hops, far side), which moves spawnFodder's breach off the gate lane.
Put openBackDoor inside the one-line storyApi; rejected to keep the diff mergeable with the other agents editing that line: it is an Object.assign on its own lines right after it.

Frame the collapse with the sinkhole's pose (5 cells up, 4 toward the pole); kept for the sinkhole, but for the mouth it looks outward over empty rock, so the collapse takes a pose from outside looking in.
evidence: node test/back-door.mjs: the pinned mouth, beyond and flank; ~110 hops through the gate to <= 17 through the back for the lane beyond; 13,408 routes shortened; 272 candidates at 40-51 hops, identical before and after the collapse; every candidate's descent on the collapsed route field crosses the fallen rock; the lane end is not a back cell. test/world-recipe.mjs: buildGameWorld carries story.backMouth [1086, 34817].

scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --backdoor (run 1, before the framing change): stage 6 wallCount 43,015 (was 68,497) with 28,299 open cells, exactly the Node prediction for no gating; collapse of 6 cells, call 6.9 ms, max rAF delta 22.5 ms over 2.5 s against a 19.3 ms baseline, no longtask entries in either window; the wall count dropped by 6; a second call returned 0; nearest back candidate route < 60 hops and equal to its planned hops; 16 fodder on a back breach reached the clearing on the back half. Screenshots artifacts/browser/backdoor-*.png.

Runs 1 and 2 measured the collapse with no shot on screen: at the stage-8 load a hull is still rolling out of its bay, and updateCameraGoal gives the deploy framing priority over any shot, so the dive ran unseen with the board frozen (both dive stills show the deploy camera). openBackDoor now skips the dive while a hull deploys; the step waits for the roll-out. Run 3, with the dive rendering: call 6.8 ms, one long task of 70 ms, max rAF delta 78.4 ms (122 frames in 2.5 s against 150 and 22.1 ms at baseline): under the 100 ms target, but the frame cost comes from the shot, not the rebuild.

Run 4 (dive on screen, cut to orbit): the call took 11.3 ms, then a 119 ms long task and a 130.9 ms frame 131 ms after the call. That is the pre-roll cutting to a whole-planet frame from 3.3 radii, not the rebuild. Fix: startDiveShot gained fromCamera, and the collapse glides from the current camera. Run 5 on the final commit 8c5f70e: stage 6 wall count 43,015; stage 8 collapse of 6 cells (wall count down by exactly 6); call 9.6 ms; no long tasks; max frame 55 ms at +55 ms against a 20.7 ms baseline; every step PASS (stage6, dive, mouth, swarm-inside).
On the final commit 8c5f70e, --defense passed all six steps and --story-world passed every step.
npm test (110 programs) and npm run check green at each commit.
